## Are you ready to step into AI robotics ? 🌟

**[​42AI](https://42-ai.github.io) is delighted to team up with 🤗 HugginFace 🤗 to bring you LeRobot Worldwide Hackathon - AI Robotics Global Challenge ! 🌍 🦾**

Join us for a wild week-end on a global hackathon to learn, train, and solve real-world problems using open-source tech !

### What is it about ? 💡

**We live in a wild time! The ChatGPT moment of robotics could be just a few milestones away! Come help us make our future more open and accessible to all !**

📍 Where ? 42, 96 Boulevard Bessières, 75017 PARIS, France

📆 When ? June, Saturday the 14th and Sunday the 15th !

👉 Find out all the relevant information about the challenge [on the dedicated page](https://huggingface.co/LeRobot-worldwide-hackathon).

### ​Why join ? 🙋

- Easy-to-follow tutorials (beginner-friendly!)
- Discover the all-new LeRobot SO-101
- Take part in a global event with more than 3000 participants !
- A vibrant community of curious minds !
​

✅ Open to all - No experience ? No problem !

**​Looking forward to seeing you at 42UP ! Let's turn the world into one giant robotics lab together !**
